expectationHash: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON expected object; sorted keys, compact separators, unescaped Unicode
versionRule: Bump normalizationVersion for deliberate parsing behavior changes. Update only independently re-reviewed expectations, increment their reviewVersion and record reason/date. Structural refactors without behavior changes keep the version.

changes.reason: Baseline after region-only and empty-detail fixes.
Remove whitespace before Bulgarian commas and standalone trailing dot/hyphen place placeholders; retain decimal commas and attached abbreviation periods.
Space recognized Bulgarian quarter marker кв. before its value while preserving embedded ordinary words and original provider text.

Omit whole comma-separated Bulgarian complex/block/entrance/floor/apartment components with asterisk-only values from structured delivery lines; preserve genuine starred values, unknown markers and original source text.
Move explicitly labelled сграда/стая components with values at start or comma boundary into address2; protect street names and empty labels.
Repair lowercase ул./бул. glued to uppercase complex name under explicit жк. prefix; preserve ordinary embedded markers.

User-approved BG structured-address presentation: strip double quotation glyphs, canonical жк., uppercase single entrance letters, omit explicit delivery post-box components; preserve raw text, apostrophes and four-digit postcodes.
